title: St Michael and All Angels Church, Blantyre
scope: The original red-brick St Michael and All Angels Church, its occupied historic footprint, west towers, attached Moorish stair turret and central dome in Blantyre, Malawi.
limitations: The historical church alone is represented. The separate modern church, detached clock tower and school are omitted.
Vault shapes and fabric damage are outside the exterior model. Small masonry ornament, tower heights and modern roof tones are approximated from the photographs and construction record.
